When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

message.content:
Let \(I = \int 2*exp(x)*cos(x)\,dx\).

Using the standard integral:
\[
\int exp(x)*cos(x)\,dx = \frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}
\]

Then:
\[
I = 2*\left(\frac{exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))}{2}\right) + C
\]

So:
\[
I = exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x)) + C
\]

<answer>exp(x)*(sin(x) + cos(x)) + C</answer>
